title: VB4 IDE anatomy: five labeled panels
brief: Add the script’s exact panel callouts to the sourced VB4 IDE while preserving the authentic screenshot.
requirements: Use only the accepted HIST-02 original. Required labels: Form Designer, Toolbox, Properties Window, Code Window, Project Explorer.
Verify that the sourced VB4 screenshot contains or supports each requested panel name. If a label belongs to another version or the panel is not visible, flag it; do not paint it into the original.
Keep arrows outside code/text where possible and make each target unmistakable. Provide both unannotated framed image and annotated version.
Carry forward the original image rights/credit and record all annotation edits.
beats: Annotated still: reveal one labeled panel at a time only if requested by the editor; static full-label export is required.
checks: Each of the five labels has a verified target or an explicit unresolved blocker.
Underlying HIST-02 is unchanged and traceable.
No version-specific UI is invented to make the callouts fit.
copy:
Form Designer
Toolbox
Properties Window
Code Window
Project Explorer
